content.text:
Built a complete, playable dating sim in `index.html`. It includes three adult romance routes, choice-driven chemistry and trust, energy and money management, venue changes, text messages, a day-by-day week, and multiple endings. The responsive layout supports phone, tablet, and desktop touch controls.

I kept the “R-rated” tone to mature themes, adult language, and non-explicit romance; intimacy fades to black, and all characters are adults. The presentation uses illustrated 2D scenes rather than 3D.

**Checks:** JavaScript syntax validation passed. I couldn’t verify the game in a browser because Chromium isn’t installed in this environment.
